Page.Title: Plain textarea
Page.Subtitle: Raven's TextEditor is made for code. <PlainTextArea> (src/widgets.xml) turns that off to get a textarea as on the web: no line numbers, no highlighted line, no proposals or closing brackets, the font of the interface, wrapped lines. Compare with the code editor below.
